ENSO Alert System Status: El Niño Advisory

Synopsis: El Niño is expected to continue through the Northern Hemisphere winter 2026-27 (98% chance in October-December 2026).

The next ENSO Diagnostics Discussion is scheduled for 12 November 2026.
